items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: It’s best to call ahead on {phoneLink}. We’ll agree on a date and tell you roughly how long the repair will take.

items.q: How much does a repair cost?
items.a: It depends on the fault and the car model. Before the repair we tell you what needs doing and what it will cost, parts included.

items.q: How long does a repair take?
items.a: It depends on the fault and on parts availability. We agree on a pick-up date before starting work.
